configuration.biomarker_selection: A candidate must be a significant human DEG, include at least one additional evidence category, and have at least one cross-dimensional network support category (hub support across at least two centrality metrics, measured network drift, or observed lost/gained interactions). DEG alone, module association alone, and orthology alone do not qualify. Eligible candidates are ordered by evidence-category count, adjusted p-value, and absolute log2 fold change; no composite biomarker score is used.

limitations: Research prioritization only, not a clinical risk estimate.
Human cancer and mouse cancer networks differ substantially in size and density.
Mouse expression is from an independent-study exploratory comparison and is reported but excluded from the score.
Absence of a one-to-one orthology record is not proof of genomic deletion.
Missing evidence is null and excluded from the normalized score; it is not replaced with zero.
